notes.zh-CN: 侧边栏会话列表：每个项目组默认只显示最近 10 条会话，其余折叠为「显示 N 条更多会话」，展开后可再次收起；当前打开的会话始终保持可见。本次提供 macOS universal 与 Windows x64 / ARM64 安装包。
notes.en: Sidebar session list: each project group now shows only the 10 most recent sessions; the rest collapse behind a "Show N more sessions" row that expands and collapses again, and the session you have open always stays visible. This release ships the macOS universal installer and the Windows x64 and ARM64 installers.
